triples.head_surface: exposed machined parts and surfaces of the pump
triples.tail_surface: Apply oil or grease (silicone-free oil and grease, food-approved if required)
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 涂抹无硅油或润滑脂（必要时使用食品级）
triples.evidence_text:
Apply oil or grease (silicone-free oil and grease, food-approved if required) on all exposed
        machined parts and surfaces of the pump (with silicone-free oil and grease, food-approved if
        required) to protect them against corrosion.

triples.head_surface: wetted components made of low-alloy materials
triples.evidence_text:
If the pump set is to be stored temporarily, only preserve the wetted components made of low-alloy
        materials.

triples.tail_surface:
Do all servicing / maintenance operations before returning the pump
      (set) to service
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 恢复投运前完成所有保养/维护作业
triples.evidence_text:
Do all servicing / maintenance operations before returning the pump
      (set) to service.

triples.tail_surface:
re-install and/or re-activate all safety-relevant and
                  protective devices
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 重新安装和/或重新启用所有安全相关及防护装置
triples.evidence_text:
Moving parts or excaping fluid could cause death or serious injury.
                  Immediately after the work is complete, re-install and/or re-activate all safety-relevant and
                  protective devices.

triples.tail_canonical_zh: 更换全部弹性体密封件
triples.evidence_text: NOTE: If the pump has been out of service for more than one year, replace all elastomer seals.
